affliction.description: An extended respiratory disease, tuberculosis can pose particular challenges to spellcasters and some performers due to the intense coughing fits it produces.
affliction.name: Tuberculosis

stages.effect: coughing requires you to succeed at a DC 5 flat check to Cast a Spell that has the concentrate trait or Activate an Item that has the concentrate trait
stages.name: Stage 2

stages.effect: fatigued, can’t recover from the fatigued condition, and coughing requires a successful DC 15 flat check to Cast a Spell that has the concentrate trait or Activate an Item that has the concentrate trait
stages.name: Stage 3

traits.name: Disease
traits.text: An effect with this trait applies one or more diseases. A disease is typically an affliction.
